memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: This is the written account of Adam's family line. When God created mankind, he made them in the likeness of God. He created them male and female and blessed them and called them "mankind" when they were created. - Gen 5:1-2 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Before this chapter lists a long line of names and ages, it pauses to remind us of something precious: human beings were made "in the likeness of God." Even after the fall, even outside Eden, this truth still stands. Every person in the list that follows - and every person you will meet today - carries the image of their Maker.

Notice too that God "blessed them." Humanity begins not under a frown but under a blessing. And notice He made them "male and female," both equally bearing His likeness, both equally loved.

This is the foundation of human dignity. We do not earn our worth by achievement, beauty, or usefulness. We have it because God stamped His image on us. That is why every life matters - the unborn, the elderly, the weak, the stranger, the difficult neighbour.

The New Testament shows us the perfect image of God in Jesus Christ (Col 1:15), and promises that all who belong to Him are being remade into that likeness (2 Cor 3:18). The dignity you were given at creation is being restored and perfected in Christ. Treat yourself and every person you meet today as an image-bearer of God.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you truly believe every person bears God's image?
- How would you treat others differently if you did?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You for stamping Your image on me and blessing me. Help me honour that image in myself and in every person I meet today.
